skill.name: elite-mvp-master
skill.description: Development guidance for building production-ready OC Pipeline features with React, Node.js, Supabase, and Vercel.
skill.summary: Guides high-quality software development for OC Pipeline and related construction SaaS work.
skill.author: ALPA-Const

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in the single prompt-only skill file. Manual review found no executable code, external command use, network access, credential handling, or audit-directed prompt injection.

content.value_statement: Construction SaaS work needs secure, complete code that non-developers can implement. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to produce full files, clear steps, and production-focused decisions.
actual_capabilities: Sets development standards for clean, production-ready code.
Frames work around OC Pipeline and construction management software.
Emphasizes security, scalability, maintainability, error handling, and documentation.
Supports React, Node.js, Supabase, Vercel, database, and API development requests.
Requires complete working code instead of placeholders or partial snippets.
Requires simple numbered implementation steps for non-technical users.
limitations: Does not include executable scripts, helper tools, or reusable code files.
Does not provide project-specific source code beyond prompting guidance.
Depends on the assistant and repository context for technical accuracy.
Names a specific user and project, so it may need editing for other teams.

use_cases.title: Build OC Pipeline Features
use_cases.description: Create complete feature code with security, scalability, and maintainability considered from the start.

use_cases.title: Fix Application Bugs
use_cases.description: Produce complete fixes with clear implementation steps and no assumed developer knowledge.

use_cases.title: Review Stack Decisions
use_cases.description: Guide choices for React, Node.js, Supabase, Vercel, databases, and APIs in a production context.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Feature
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a complete feature implementation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use elite-mvp-master to build a complete OC Pipeline feature for [feature]. Include full files, error handling, and numbered implementation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Fix a Bug
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a focused production fix.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use elite-mvp-master to fix this bug: [bug description]. Explain what you are fixing, provide complete replacement code, and list exact steps.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Database Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request involving Supabase and application logic.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use elite-mvp-master to design and implement a Supabase-backed workflow for [workflow]. Include schema changes, API logic, UI updates, and validation.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Production Release
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for implementation, deployment, and quality checks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use elite-mvp-master to prepare a production-ready release plan for [feature]. Include code changes, security checks, tests, deployment steps, and rollback notes.

output_examples.input: Build a subcontractor invitation feature for OC Pipeline.
output_examples.output: A complete implementation plan with full file contents, validation behavior, email flow notes, and numbered deployment steps.

output_examples.input: Fix the bid dashboard loading error.
output_examples.output: A direct bug summary, replacement files, error handling improvements, and exact steps a non-developer can follow.

output_examples.input: Add Supabase tables for project documents.
output_examples.output: A production-focused database design, access rules, API behavior, UI integration notes, and verification steps.

best_practices: Provide the current repository context and the exact feature or bug request.
Ask for complete file changes when the implementation affects multiple layers.
Review generated steps before applying changes to production systems.
anti_patterns: Do not use it as a substitute for security review of generated application code.
Do not apply generated database or deployment changes without checking the target environment.
Do not use the project-specific wording unchanged for unrelated clients or products.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It guides assistants to build, fix, and explain OC Pipeline software work with production quality expectations.

faq.question: Does it run code or install dependencies?
faq.answer: No. The skill is a prompt-only instruction file and does not include executable code.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it only for OC Pipeline?
faq.answer: It is written for OC Pipeline and federal-grade construction software, but teams can adapt the wording.

faq.question: Can non-developers use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill asks for simple numbered implementation steps and avoids unexplained technical jargon.

faq.question: Does it guarantee secure generated code?
faq.answer: No. It encourages secure development standards, but generated code still needs review and testing.
